title: woodsia mollis
intro: Woodsia mollis, commonly known as the lady fern or southern lady fern, is a species of fern in the genus Woodsia. It is a type of flowering plant, but it belongs to the division Pteridophyta, which consists of vascular plants that produce spores instead of seeds. The health benefits of Woodsia mollis include its potential to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation, which can be attributed to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
